description: This file defines the ReminderManager class responsible for scheduling, canceling, rescheduling reminders, and sending notifications within an Android app. It interacts with Android system services like AlarmManager and NotificationManager, and manages reminder data via repositories.

classes.name: ReminderManager
classes.description: A class managing scheduling, canceling, rescheduling reminders, and sending notifications in the app.

methods.name: requestBroadcast
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for a reminder broadcast with specified reminder and note IDs.

methods.name: isReminderSet
methods.description: Checks if a reminder is already scheduled.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a reminder at a specified date and time.

methods.name: cancelAllRemindersForNote
methods.description: Cancels all reminders associated with a specific note.

methods.name: rescheduleAll
methods.description: Reschedules all reminders, deleting expired ones.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification when a reminder fires, with deep linking to the note editor.
